items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: there were two members of the Italian guys... another guy was the second trombone player by the name of Cesario... I wrote my solo -- it kind of appealed to him

ctx.x: I see. Okay, you didn't speak any Italian but nevertheless how did the people of Italy react to the music and also to yourself?

Yeah, well you know music is the common language in all nationalities and there were two members of the Italian guys, one's name was Gino, he was a guitar player and another guy was the second trombone player by the name of Cesario and they called him Caesar for short and I wrote my solo -- it kind of appealed to him, I think he's still got it.
